text:
Maya (docs): Hey team — have a PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/462 that updates the migration guide and adds a Python SDK snippet. Need reviewer assign and merge timing. Docs preview failing link-check on one internal anchor. Can someone pick up review? /cc @Tom H @Sarah - Eng

Tom H: I can take the migration guide portion. Will check the preview.

docs-bot: Preview build failed: link-check error — 1 broken link at /guides/migrate.html#old-anchor

Maya (docs): Thanks Tom. Ali, can you review the SDK snippet? It adds sample using streaming + function calling. Short change.

Ali R: I can, later today. FYI tests pass locally. Need to confirm code style with black formatting.

Sarah - Eng: If you need eng signoff on API surface, I can look after lunch. ETA ~14:00 PT.

Tom H: Found the broken anchor — the header got renamed in the newer guide. Quick fix: change link to #upgrading-pipelines. Also spotted a TODO about quantization profiles that might be worth calling out. I'll push a tiny commit to the PR.

Maya (docs): Awesome. @Courtney would you be willing to be reviewer owner for docs-migration area? We are short in rotation this week.

Courtney: I can for this week. Also can we add a small OWNERS file in /docs/migration to track rotation?

Ali R: :thumbsup: OWNERS file sounds good. I'll open a follow-up PR after this merges.

Tom H: CI preview rerun queued. pinging #eng-docs-reviewers in case anyone else can help.

Sarah - Eng: Patch LGTM from eng side, one nit: change "dedicated capacity" -> "dedicated pools" in the migration example.

Maya (docs): Noted, will apply. Who will merge? We have a merge window today 17:00-18:00 PT; prefer to land in that window.

Courtney: I can merge after 17:00 PT once CI is green.

Maya (docs): Thanks all. Summary -> Tom fixes link & pushes, Ali reviews SDK snippet, Sarah does API check, Courtney merges in 17:00-18:00 window. I'll add OWNERS follow-up. Marking thread resolved unless anything blocks.

Tom H: Pushed fix: `git commit -m 'fix(migrate): update migration anchor'` and pushed. Preview now shows 0 link errors.

docs-bot: Preview build passed: all checks green. Deployed staging preview: https://deploy-preview-462--docs.redwood.com

Courtney: :thumbsup: I'll merge at 17:05 PT.

Maya (docs): Merged. Thanks team :tada:
